budget_items.topic: Fire department Sunday shift staffing cost, PDM coverage vs. career firefighters
budget_items.what_was_said: A public commenter said last year she pointed out the cost difference between PDM ambulance coverage and hiring career firefighters for the Sunday shift. She suggested the Sunday shift could again be added without an override, as is being done this year.

budget_items.topic: FY26 school department level-services budget request
budget_items.what_was_said: A commenter recalled the school department requesting an increase for level services in the FY26 process and said she raised concerns the numbers did not align.

budget_items.topic: FY25 override funds left unspent by the school department
budget_items.what_was_said: The commenter said a portion of the FY25 override went unspent due to lack of tracking under the former superintendent, which she said hurt students.

budget_items.topic: New assistant town hall manager position
budget_items.what_was_said: The commenter said the town manager's balanced budget adds a new assistant town hall manager position at an added cost, while eliminating one existing position.

budget_items.topic: Town reserve account vs. financial policy threshold
budget_items.what_was_said: The commenter said the balanced budget sets aside a reserve amount well above what the town's financial policy calls for.

budget_items.topic: New revenue used for capital expenses including vehicles
budget_items.what_was_said: The commenter said new revenue is being used for capital expenses including vehicles rather than drawing from an existing reserve account.
The commenter listed the band concert as a small service being eliminated in the balanced budget.
The commenter cited the town beach's net cost as another small service affected by budget choices.
The commenter framed the eliminated small services as insignificant relative to the total town budget, but said they matter to affected families and seniors.

budget_items.topic: School reserve accounts vs. amount needed for current services
budget_items.what_was_said: The commenter questioned why school reserve accounts exceed what she said is needed to maintain current services, given warnings that schools would be devastated if the override fails.

budget_items.topic: 41A property tax deferral and circuit breaker eligibility thresholds
budget_items.what_was_said: A resident described income and home-value thresholds under the state's 41A deferral and circuit breaker tax credit programs, saying eligibility is broader than residents realize.

budget_items.topic: State income tax circuit breaker credit
budget_items.what_was_said: The same resident said qualifying residents could also get an income tax break under the circuit breaker program.

budget_items.topic: Means-tested tax relief program income and asset limits
budget_items.what_was_said: The resident described household income and asset limits for a means-tested relief program, encouraging seniors to check eligibility with the assessors.

decisions.decision: Board held off formally appointing the AFSCME/SAP representative to the sick leave bank committee, since it was not specifically posted on this agenda; to be brought back on a future agenda.
Board agreed to hold the vote on 250 and 356 Hollis Road open until May 12th to allow time for input from planning, agricultural, open space/conservation, and assessors.
Board agreed the Hollis Road referral to those boards/committees can go out now rather than waiting for a future meeting.
Board agreed to wait until after annual town meeting before resuming work on the special event policy.
Board agreed members need more time to review the updated employee climate survey questions before approving them, aiming to issue the survey sometime in May.
Board agreed to ask town counsel (Adam) whether the FY27 budget/override open house needs to be posted as an open meeting given a possible quorum of members attending.

public_comment.topic: Disputed override supporters' claims that the balanced budget cuts fire and police services, criticized how the FY25 override funds were tracked and spent, and argued the current override option does not let voters choose to maintain level services.

Urged residents, especially seniors, to look into the 41A tax deferral, circuit breaker credit, means-tested relief program, and senior tax workoff program, tying this to the consequences of the override vote.

minutes.summary: The Select Board handled routine business -- a class 2 motor vehicle license, a one-day liquor license, lifeguard/beach director appointments, a videographer resignation, and setting a July 1 start date for the new sick leave bank policy -- alongside a town manager update on IFBs, recruitments, and town meeting logistics. The most substantive content was extended public comment in which a resident challenged claims that the FY27 balanced budget and override option cut fire and police services, followed by another resident promoting property-tax relief programs; the meeting closed by voting to enter executive session over firefighter and AFSCME collective bargaining strategy.

what_happened.line: A resident used public comment to dispute claims from override supporters that the FY27 balanced budget cuts fire and police services.
The Select Board took only routine votes: a motor vehicle license, a one-day liquor license, lifeguard and beach director appointments, and a sick leave bank policy start date.
The board left open its vote on whether to sell or hold two Hollis Road parcels until May 12, to get input from other town boards first.
A second resident used public comment to promote state property-tax relief programs, tying them to the consequences of the override vote.
The board voted to enter executive session to discuss bargaining strategy for the firefighters' and AFSCME contracts.

why_it_matters: The dispute over whether the balanced budget cuts fire and police service goes to the core question residents will face on the override ballot.
The sick leave bank policy, effective July 1 with June enrollment, is a benefit change for town employees.
The Hollis Road decision affects what happens to two town-owned parcels and is not yet final.

reconciliation.summary: The two records agree closely on the mechanics of every vote except the CarXP license sequence and the roll call to enter Executive Session, and on every substantive discussion outcome (Hollis Road, sick leave bank, employee survey, special event policy, open-house posting question).
